study.question: Does within-partition variation of target/field similarity improve compressed history activation beyond the same slot first moments, counts and added scorer capacity, and does alignment to the target matter?
study.hypothesis: Observation: recent10 scored0.662624 versus equal10 0.660593 and full100 0.659749 in the r0010 family; reversing content reduced recent occupied scoring from0.662455 to0.660751. This motivates examining resolution and content, but does not establish loss of variance as their cause. The current union parent is0.6634628103 click AUC. Resolved task sums did not beat its union replacement (exact0.66345356, centroid0.66338875); new joint/marginal/shifted match counts were0.66342498/0.66343216/0.66345856, all below parent. Earlier learned pre-pool versus post-pool ReLU codes differed by only -0.00002066 for blocked sources, also not support. Proposed mechanism: averages erase heterogeneity in per-event target similarity; a bounded second-moment sketch can adjust a compressed slot activation without a learned event-level scorer or additional history. This is an untested mechanism, not an explanation established by those trajectories. Baseline auxiliary AUCs0.84907/0.86490/0.87018 exceed parent0.74687/0.77254/0.74344; selection is click only and no all-task superiority is claimed.

nearest_work.difference: Archived exact-version primary text lines250-277 inspected: target-local per-event unnormalized activation and weighted sum are inherited ideas. This proposal applies a small correction to the local compressed scorer using slot field cosine moments, while keeping its thirty slots. It is not an exact DIN reproduction, nor an analytically unbiased approximation to DIN.

Pinned benchmark lines144-234 split recent/earlier histories and form fixed plus feature queries for tokenizing retrieval. Here the existing local partition is frozen and no new query tokens/cross-attention/mixer are adopted; second moments replace squared means in the compressed activation input. Original paper:hemix detail is unavailable through the authorized source and no paper-level equivalence or novelty exclusion is asserted.

Prior local nonlinear event-code timing experiment was not positive against pool_encode_blocked. The new mechanism uses fixed field cosine statistics, no learned event encoder, and modifies shared slot activations instead of adding auxiliary code readouts; it must earn support independently.

Inspected supplied ancestor source and receipt. Prior added heads received hard target-match/task count intersections after compression. Here task identities are not added; continuous field-similarity second moments enter slot selection itself. The prior null result remains counterevidence against generic claims that any extra target-history statistic helps.

study.proposed_difference: Add one shared zero-output Linear-ReLU-Linear correction per occupied slot. For each authorized item field, unit-normalize current target and historical field embeddings in FP32; compute s=cos(q,k) and r=cos(roll(q,1),k). All four cells compute and expose the same slot E[s], E[r], value mean, context, target, count/100 and age sign. The sole selected six-number block is either E[s^2], E[s]^2, E[r^2] or E[r]^2. Correction is added to the incumbent activation before its existing count-weighted pooling and all downstream readouts; no learned event scoring or new embedding table. Auxiliary losses use the detached correction, including detached new context path; click trains it. This small factorial isolates second-moment information conditional on common first moments and nominal capacity. It is a local hypothesis and no verified originality claim.
predictions: Primary predeclared contrast: click AUC(aligned_event)-AUC(aligned_centroid)>0 with matched recipe; Logloss and all auxiliary tasks reported separately.

Alignment-sensitive heterogeneity predicts interaction [aligned_event-aligned_centroid]-[rotated_event-rotated_centroid]>0. If both timing contrasts improve equally, support generic projected spread rather than correct target alignment.

Candidate should also beat the union parent to justify added complexity. A gain over parent without a timing contrast is only support for the common correction architecture/capacity, not second moments.

For empty, singleton and constant-similarity slots, event and centroid statistics are equal for a fixed query; a direct oracle must confirm this. No forecast of identical trained-model predictions on these sample slices.

A frozen untrained tensor counterexample has equal value/first-moment inputs but different event second moments. This establishes information distinction only; benchmark utility and latency savings remain unmeasured.

All cells add identical13505 nominal parameters on the inherited schema. No predicted efficiency win over parent; judge actual measured quality-cost tradeoff. Old full100 cost is context, not a matched frontier comparator.
falsifiers: Aligned event fails to improve over aligned centroid, or the direction reverses under paired repetitions: this implementation has no controlled support for useful second-moment retention.
Event effects are the same in aligned and rotated queries: the stronger target-alignment explanation is unsupported even if generic spread helps.
Only comparison to parent improves while matched timing replacements tie: added common capacity/first-moment/context features are sufficient alternatives.

Any padding, gradient-source, initialization, buffer-ownership or direct-statistics oracle failure invalidates the run as a mechanism contrast; retain failure costs without calling it scientific refutation.
Quality benefit is smaller than repeated-seed variation or unacceptable relative to measured cost: do not select this mechanism on a single marginal AUC win.
alternative_explanations: Historical recency trials change Dice populations, variance and inductive bias together; they do not diagnose lost similarity dispersion.
Added common per-slot context conditioning, normalized first moments, counts, age or correction capacity may explain any gain versus parent.
Rotation is an imperfect alignment control: learned embeddings can coadapt, and rotated projections still contain target information. No pure target-dependence identification is claimed.
Cosine normalization discards scale and may create large derivatives at near-zero norms; inherited mean/action values still carry scale. Direct oracle and gradient checks are necessary.
Second moments of field-wise scalar similarities omit cross-field and value/similarity covariance; a null result does not refute richer moment representations.
One epoch, fixed seed, adaptive validation reuse and multiplicity limit inference. Same-seed historical reruns are not independent repetitions.
Released auxiliary labels match user/category/brand over24h and official offline historical feedback may be immature at serving time; no production-causal or advertisement-conversion claim.

variants.name: aligned_event
variants.note: Candidate: select E[cos(q,k)^2] in each slot/field. New shared slot scorer correction has one 32-unit ReLU layer, no Dice, and zero final weight/bias. Added parameters = 32*(context_width+key_width+value_width+3*item_field_count+3)+33. With inherited 12 context fields, six item fields and width16: 13505 added; expected 32295406 total / 502190 dense / 31793216 embedding, to be measured by host. Auxiliary correction is detached in its entirety, including its context path; this is identical in every cell and leaves existing auxiliary context paths open. No training-loss change. Host prerequisites, not executed locally (torch unavailable): finite FP32/BF16 forward/backward on full, partial, empty and holey histories; evaluation B=1 and supported training batches; four [B,1] outputs with permuted label order. Verify padded item/action/task-mask perturbation invariance, target-action exclusion and arbitrary overlapping task masks. Compare all six statistics tensors against direct per-event FP32 oracles using the same thirty all/nonfeedback/feedback memberships; counts must equal inherited compression counts. Event second moment minus squared mean must be nonnegative within tolerance, zero for empty/singleton/constant-similarity slots, and bounded by one for unit-normalized fields. Test zero-norm embeddings and near-zero norms without NaN or exploding derivatives; measure their frequency rather than assuming none. All cells expose identical means/counts/context/target/value/age and compute both query and timing views. A two-event +/-e1 versus +/-e2 example with target e1 has identical common first moments/raw means but distinct aligned second moments. Check the rotation stays within each field and preserves norm. Verify equal new shapes/initialization, inherited state keys/values and post-construction CPU RNG; zero correction must reproduce parent predictions and inherited Dice updates. With nonzero correction, isolated auxiliary losses must have zero gradients into correction parameters, scorer and shared item/action tables, while context and auxiliary readouts retain their inherited gradients; click loss must reach correction and its input sources. Only primary scorer may persist Dice state; original empty/one-row rules remain. Check mask-zero correction rows, train/eval reuse, sparse/dense optimizer ownership and nonpersistent buffers/device moves. Abort on failed prerequisites, preserve charged costs and diagnose before another run. Report all four AUC/Logloss, primary history slices with samples/positive/negative counts, train/inference examples, wall/GPU seconds, peak memory and model-batch p50/p95 latency.
